note: A template, not a list: the entries name roles, never models, because model ids go stale and a host may be on another provider. A host writes its own ~/.config/task-pipeline/judge-models.json (or passes --models) with concrete ids from its model map; spec_judge.py refuses to call a placeholder and exits 3 when nothing callable is left. The estate's model owner edits the host file like any other change.
